symbols.name: IConcurrency
symbols.summary: Represents an interface used for entities that support concurrent access control. It is used to address issues related to concurrency in data operations by incorporating a version attribute that can be used for optimistic locking mechanisms.

symbols.name: ConcurrencyVersion
symbols.summary: Gets or sets the version identifier for the entity. This property is typically used for concurrency control, ensuring that updates to the entity are only applied if the version identifier matches the expected value.
symbols.remarks: A new version identifier is usually generated each time the entity is inserted, updated, or marked as deleted. The version identifier is commonly represented as a GUID.
